briefdescription.para: Requests the Chunk at the given coordinates to be loaded, and keeps it resident until it is released again.

detaileddescription.para: The chunk is held from the moment this returns until unloadChunk() or unloadChunkRequest() releases it, or the server restarts. Bedrock has no synchronous chunk load, so unless the chunk was already resident the load finishes on a later tick and isChunkLoaded() may still report false right afterwards. A chunk held this way stays in memory but is not ticked, and the hold never expires on its own. Intended for keeping a handful of chunks resident; it is not suited to loading large regions.
The hold is not attributed to any plugin and survives that plugin being disabled. Use addPluginChunkTicket() for a hold that is released automatically.

parameterdescription.para: Whether to generate the chunk if it does not exist yet

simplesect.para: false if generate is false and the chunk has not been generated, or if the coordinates lie outside the world limit, otherwise true

briefdescription.para: Releases the hold that loadChunk() placed on the Chunk at the given coordinates, and unloads it if nothing else keeps it resident.

detaileddescription.para: A chunk kept alive by a nearby player, the spawn area, a /tickingarea or a plugin chunk ticket stays loaded, and this reports false. Unloading a chunk saves it and fires a ChunkUnloadEvent, which handlers observe before this returns.

simplesect.para: This also completes any chunk unloads the dimension had pending, so calling it once per chunk over a large area is expensive. Use unloadChunkRequest() when releasing many chunks at once.
true if the chunk is no longer loaded, otherwise false

briefdescription.para: Releases the hold that loadChunk() placed on the Chunk at the given coordinates, without unloading it now.

detaileddescription.para: The chunk is unloaded on a later tick once nothing else keeps it resident.

briefdescription.para: Adds a plugin ticket for the Chunk at the given coordinates, loading it if it is not already loaded.

detaileddescription.para: A plugin ticket keeps the chunk resident until it is explicitly removed or the owning plugin is disabled. A plugin may only have one ticket per chunk, but each chunk can have multiple plugin tickets. unloadChunk() does not remove plugin tickets.

simplesect.para: true if a plugin ticket was added, false if the plugin already holds one for this chunk
